CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sgp_pdt_manual.proteger_anio_programacion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.anio IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.anio THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PDT_PRODUCTION_YEAR_IMMUTABLE: %',OLD.key_produccion;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
